steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each tooling item must be ready for its trial, each trial needs a result, and sign-off comes before production.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Tooling item not ready for its trial
findings.fix: Hold the trial until the tooling is ready

findings.title: Trial with no result
findings.fix: Record the result before the next gate

findings.title: Sign-off missing before production
findings.fix: Do not start production until sign-off

outcome.notChecked: Whether the product meets the customer's specification.

example:

pros: Checks a tooling item not ready for its trial, a trial with no result, and a sign-off missing before production.
cons: Not checked: Whether the product meets the customer's specification.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-npi-checklist skill on the records for this review.
